excludedFromGitCopies.scope: Never traverse or copy these raw/profile/build/dependency trees into Git. Reject unexpected raw files inside an allowed packet group. Keep only their existing metadata/digest descriptors in receipts.
excludedFromGitCopies.sourceDirectoryQualification: Exclude the assigned build/runtime directory roots, not source directories merely named server. Pinned src/server source required by an extracted proof packet remains included.

boundedFileSetChecks: Apply this success retention plan only after root authenticates passing capture, independent wrapper closure, finite native lifetime closure, fresh seal/custody, approved extraction and one-shot native audit for the same sourcePin and matchId. Preserve earlier failures regardless of this gate.

Resolve future paths from root-created authenticated descriptors; no glob-based choice of the newest /tmp directory. The manifest is incomplete until every required resolver has a concrete original path.

Enumerate only the 14 declared packet groups, never the whole runtime prefix or dependency/build/profile/raw directories. Require regular files and reject symlinks, sockets, FIFOs and device entries. Record a bounded complete relative path set for each group.

Require each group required-file set, including zero-byte logs. Unexpected files must be recorded and classified, not silently omitted. Raw/database/profile/build/dependency matches are excluded before any content read or copy.

After runtime closure, create source records for each nonraw file with relative path, byte count, SHA256 and mode. Preserve original bytes/modes. Compare complete sorted source/destination path sets and every file record, then recheck sources for mutation.

Use the authoritative runtime caps for lifecycle/public/collector/audit groups. An exceeded cap is a preservation/import qualification; never truncate, prune or fabricate passing records. Future extraction/operator group bounds come from their exact declared manifests and reported byte totals.
Retain the first unapproved extraction whole, and the approved copy whole. Keep promotion receipts and exact diff; no overwrite or loss of the initial authority state.
Validate that raw custody remains external, mode0444, under the root custody descriptor. This plan never opens, hashes, queries, copies, seals or extracts raw and never imports itself.

Retain all original finite-closure qualifiers including unobservedDescendantsExcluded=false. Separate wrapper closure from native lifetime closure, and retain the earlier R5 rejected-proc-state and causal-wording qualifications.

Keep existing preparation and failure evidence in place. Reference their original root manifests and commits; do not revise historical pass/fail fields or infer a verified count until root final admission is retained.

historicalQualifications.oldFailureCausalWordingQualification: R5 driver recorded missing snapshot/live PIDFD, then terminated public producer; null summary/cleanup are observed, attribution to internal producer state remains inferred. Original row is preserved.
